question: Where was the headquarters of the Home Rule League founded by Bal Gangadhar Tilak located?
solution: The correct answer is __**Pune**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The headquarters of the **Home Rule League** founded by **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** was established in **Pune** in **1916**. • The league was inspired by the Irish Home Rule Movement and aimed at achieving **self-governance** for India within the British Empire. • Tilak’s Home Rule League focused on **political education** and creating a widespread demand for **Swaraj** (self-rule). • The league actively campaigned through public meetings, pamphlets, newspapers, and petitions, gaining massive support across India. • Tilak’s efforts in Pune inspired other leaders like **Annie Besant**, who also started her own Home Rule League in **Madras** the same year.
